title: Been working on my game Puzzle Rush for a few months new, getting ready to release soon!
author: Ukawok92
selftext:
Been working on this game for a few months now, using mostly Claude code.

I'm working on getting it on the Google Play Store right now, then iOS, then Steam.

Some features and game modes:

\- VS AI Mode with 12 bosses and unique stages. Including a speed run mode with leaderboards and replays.  
\- Time Trial mode with leaderboards and replays  
\- Endless mode with leaderboards and replays  
\- Puzzle Mode with 90 puzzles  
\- A community mode where anyone can design a puzzle and share it for anyone to play  
\- Full 3D menu system based on our solar system  
\- Full controller support

I'd like to add online multiplayer too, but I'm focusing on getting the core game out first and I will add that later.

  
Any feedback is greatly appreciated :)
